intro.fr: Space Engineers a un APWorld communautaire, distribué sur le serveur Discord d'Archipelago.
intro.en: Space Engineers has a community APWorld, distributed on the Archipelago Discord server.

text.fr: Keen Software House sort Space Engineers en version finale en 2019.
text.en: Keen Software House releases the full version of Space Engineers in 2019.

text.fr: Le fil consacré à l'APWorld de Space Engineers est ouvert le 10 septembre 2023 sur le serveur Discord d'Archipelago, d'où il est distribué.
text.en: The thread for the Space Engineers APWorld opens on September 10, 2023 on the Archipelago Discord server, where it is distributed.
